reasoning_content: Let's wait a bit and then check the logs. pnpm install takes time (large monorepo). The backend build is done with docker compose create --build, and gradle needs to download all dependencies — it takes several minutes. Let's poll the logs.

action.command: sleep 45; tail -30 /tmp/just-up-dummy.log; echo "=== still running? ==="; pgrep -f "up.mjs" >/dev/null && echo YES || echo NO
